applications.name: PharmaCo statin adherence and LDL outcomes
applications.justification: Adherence to statin therapy and LDL cholesterol outcomes over three years; pseudonymised OMOP cohort in the SPE.
applications.intendedUse: Quantify the LDL reduction achieved under real-world adherence; expected benefit: adherence support programmes.
applications.requestedData: Adults with a statin drug exposure: drug exposures, LDL measurements, conditions; source AlphaKlinik Berlin; coverage: the OMOP warehouse.
applications.pseudonymisationJustification: Adherence is a per-person series of drug exposures over time.
applications.safeguards: Analysis only in the SPE; aggregate output with counts below five suppressed.
applications.incompleteReason: Missing: (a) the natural persons who will access the data; (i) the tools and computing resources in the secure processing environment (Art. 67(2))

missing.label: Applicant and the natural persons who will access the data
Tools and computing resources in the secure processing environment

applications.name: PharmaCo T2D Outcomes Study
applications.datasetTitle: Synthea Synthetic FHIR R4 Patient Cohort
applications.justification: Real-world outcomes of second-line type 2 diabetes therapies; pseudonymised cohort analysis in the SPE, aggregate output only.
applications.namedPersons: PharmaCo Research AG (did:web:pharmaco.de:research); Dr A. Weber, principal investigator; M. Costa, data scientist
applications.intendedUse: Compare HbA1c trajectories and cardiovascular events between second-line therapies; expected benefit: evidence for treatment guidelines and post-marketing safety.
applications.requestedData: Adults with a type 2 diabetes diagnosis: encounters, conditions, HbA1c and lipid observations, medication requests; sources AlphaKlinik Berlin and Limburg Medical Centre; coverage: the full synthetic cohort.
applications.dataFormats: FHIR R4 (EEHRxF laboratory results), OMOP CDM 5.4
applications.pseudonymisationJustification: Longitudinal linkage of the same person across encounters is needed for trajectories; anonymised snapshots would break it.
applications.safeguards: Analysis only in the secure processing environment; no record leaves it; aggregate output with counts below five suppressed; no re-identification attempt (Art. 61(2)).
applications.speTools: R 4.4 with the OHDSI HADES packages, 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM
applications.dataMinimisationStatement: Cohort restricted to adults with a T2D diagnosis; no direct identifiers leave the SPE.
